title: 팔 초
suno_analysis_sp: K-Rock with high-gain electric guitars and driving percussion. Distorted rhythm guitars play palm-muted eighth notes in the verses, opening up to power chords in the chorus. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with a bright, chorused tone. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a thick, overdriven tone. Drums feature a heavy snare and consistent crash cymbal hits during the chorus. Male vocals are delivered with a gritty, emotive belt in the higher register. The track is in the key of E major at 155 BPM in 4/4 time.
